Unit Scout

2026 CFB team ratings · every unit, ranked

How to read it

Every number is a 0–100 national rank among the 136 FBS teams — 88 means this unit grades out ahead of 88% of them.
weakelite
Units are built from 2026 returning production: each returning player (transfers included) carries his most recent on-field rating, snap-weighted. True freshmen and other newcomers have no rating yet, so they don't count. A washed-out bar tagged thin means the unit rests on few returning snaps — the grade is a guess, not a read; the top-returner line shows how much real experience is back. Overall / Offense / Defense up top are the betting model's full 2026 projection (last-year efficiency + roster + Elo), not a roster sum. The Rank badge beside the logo is the model's overall power ranking among the FBS teams (1 = best), same ordering as the power-ratings sheet.
